lines.name: Stand Up
lines.bar: The repository stands on its own: the old text UI is gone and the simulation it sat on is untouched and green; a century can be saved at any turn and picked up by another process, with every chain ruling still doing what it did; and a civkings package starts a game and proves in one command that it plays and saves
lines.note: 2026-11-19: first campaign of the civkings-one roadmap (the map-first game the design in that repository describes). The owner decided the same day that the engine builds it from the approved design. Authored on the human path; the triple was run by hand against BASE, against a lazy stub and against an honest minimum before it was sealed.

lines.name: The Map
lines.bar: python -m civkings opens a window on the simulation's world: the continent painted from the nine terrain paintings, a period atlas when zoomed out; the map is dragged, zoomed about the cursor and brought Home, the minimap jumps it, Political and Terrain switch the owners' colours; a top bar and a province panel show the simulation's own figures in any game at any turn; nothing unreadable is ever drawn, at any window size; frames are fast and the window quits clean
lines.note: 2026-11-20: the design's stage 1. The measure starts the real program headless, posts input events and reads the screen; controls are found by their labels and the figures are checked against the simulation at BASE. Authored on the human path; run by hand against BASE, a lazy window and an honest one before sealing. A PASS says the window works, not that the map is good to look at: the owner looks at the screens.
